maxStores.title: Maximum stores per country
maxStores.description: How many stores to check in each country, in directory order. Set 0 to check every store (thousands per country; a full US run checks about 9,800 pages and takes about 75 minutes).

storeKeywords.title: Only stores matching
storeKeywords.description: Only check stores whose TopCashback name contains one of these words, e.g. nike, hotel, asos. Leave empty for all stores.

minRatePercent.title: Minimum cashback (%)
minRatePercent.description: Only save stores paying at least this percentage. Stores with a fixed amount (e.g. £20) are always saved.

includeNoCashback.title: Include stores without a readable rate
includeNoCashback.description: Also save store pages where no cashback rate could be read.
